classification_policy.PASS: no hygiene hit, or only allowed business parentheses
classification_policy.AUTO_REPAIR: small local sanitize that does not change service commitments
classification_policy.BLOCK: meaning-destroying damage, internal ID/meta leak that cannot be safely stripped, or too many hits
